# Lock Ten Studio

> Software for custom home builders and the people who work on houses, made and run by a working custom builder in Cabin John, Maryland. Walkthrough (a jobsite site-report app) is live on iPhone and Android. Handover (a white-label homeowner's manual a builder gives each client) and Material Monitor (finish material tracking for builders running several homes) are in early access, each on its own site. Plainspoken, no hype, made by someone who runs a build business.

## Products

- [Walkthrough](https://lockten.ai/walkthrough): an app for builders, on iPhone and Android. Walk a job site, talk and take photos, and it generates a clean PDF report you text or email to your subcontractor from your own phone. No portal and no logins for your subs, they just get a text. Photos save to your own Google Drive or Dropbox, not your camera roll. It handles walkthroughs, trade lists, construction daily logs (dated and photo-backed, with the day's weather pulled in automatically and a weather-delay flag), owner updates, meeting notes and a persistent punch list. Three free reports to start with every feature unlocked, no credit card, then two plans: Standard at $9.99 per user per month or $99.99 per year (every report type except meeting notes and the punch list, unlimited), and Pro at $24.99 per user per month or $239.99 per year (adds meeting notes and the persistent punch list). On the App Store and Google Play as "Walkthrough: Site Reports".
- [Handover](https://homehandover.app/): a white-label homeowner's manual platform for custom builders. Every client gets an app that answers their questions from their own home's documents, plus a printed binder, both under the builder's name. In early access; the iOS app is on the App Store, and pricing is on the Handover site.
- [Material Monitor](https://materialmonitor.app/): finish material tracking for custom builders running several homes at once. One list of every finish material on every job, shared by the office on the computer and the crew on their phones, with vendor mail and carrier tracking feeding it. Live for founding builders; the iPhone app is on the way.

## About

Lock Ten Studio LLC, Cabin John, Maryland. The name refers to Lock 10 of the C&O Canal, a piece of 19th-century masonry engineering still standing. Contact: info@lockten.ai.
